To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) sustainable investors behave more socially in general; (b) there are two types sustainable investors: one group buys sustainable investments because of a personal inclination to contribute; the other group buys sustainable funds for financial reasons, such as a higher expected return; and (c) sustainable banks, such ASN Bank and Triodios bank, benefit from the loyalty and social preferences of sustainable investors, as these investors not only consider financial return but also social return when choosing their investments.
